name: Skywriter
summary:
The cost to hire a skywriter or put on a fireworks show starts around $3,500.  For less than 1/1,000 of that cost, this app offers similar experiences and more.  You can write a custom message up to 30 characters in a eight different styles using Balloons, Bats, Drones, Fireworks, Flowers, Marquee Letters, Skydivers, or a Skywriter.  There are also four pre-set messages: Prom Proposal, I Love You, Marriage Proposal, and Baby Reveal.
